title: Joint Independence Testing for Latent Position Random Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.34544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel techniques are among the most powerful methods in data science and statistics. One of the key properties of kernels contributing to their numerous successful applications is that the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is expressive enough to encode probability distributions without loss of information or to capture the joint independence of $M\ge 2$ random variables, under mild conditions. Computationally, these measures (i) rely on the so-called Gram matrix which contains the pairwise similarity of sample points, and (ii) converge at a rate $O \left(n^{-\frac{1}{2}}\right)$, where $n$ denotes the sample size. We focus on measuring the independence of latent position random graphs (LPRGs), a model widely-applied for instance in neuroscience, sociology, and epidemiology. translated_title: 潜在位置随机图的联合独立性检验
translated_abstract: 核方法是数据科学与统计学中最强大的方法之一。核方法之所以在众多应用中取得成功，其关键特性之一在于：在温和的条件下，与之对应的再生核希尔伯特空间具有足够的表达能力，既能无损地编码概率分布，又能捕捉 $M\ge 2$ 个随机变量的联合独立性。在计算方面，这些度量：(i) 依赖于所谓的格拉姆矩阵，其中包含样本点之间的两两相似度；(ii) 以 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 的速率收敛，其中 $n$ 表示样本量。我们专注于度量潜在位置随机图的独立性，该模型被广泛应用于神经科学、社会学和流行病学等领域。在潜在位置随机图中，每个节点都关联着一个潜在表示，这些表示之间的相似度（通过核来度量）决定了两个节点是否……
tldr: 本文提出基于核方法的潜在位置随机图联合独立性检验，利用格拉姆矩阵以 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 速率收敛的特性来度量图中节点潜在表示之间的独立性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes kernel-based joint independence testing for latent position random graphs, leveraging Gram matrices that converge at a rate of $O(n^{-1/2})$ to measure the independence between latent representations of graph nodes.
